Q. 1 خَذْرَفَ , (K,) inf. n. خَذْرَفَةٌ, (TA,) He hastened, sped, or went quickly. (K.) And
خَذْرَفَتْ, said of a [wild] she-ass, She hastened, sped, or went quickly, and threw out her legs. (TA.) And, said of camels, They threw the pebbles with their feet by reason of quickness. (K.) ＝
-A2- خَذْرَفَهُ He cut off his (a man's) extremities with a sword. (K.) ―
-b2- He sharpened it; namely, a sword. (K.) ―
-b3- He filled it; namely, a vessel. (Ibn-' Abbád, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
